tools.name: inspect.rows
tools.description: A window of rows from a gitten view (diff or commits). Prefers a machine source (future `inspect --json`, then the web loopback API) and falls back to parsing one headless terminal frame.

rev.description: Revspec for diff, or commit limit for commits.

tools.name: inspect.meta
tools.description: Everything about a view that a scroll does not change: label, row counts, wrap state, theme names, load timings.

rev.description: Revspec for diff, or commit limit for commits.

tools.name: inspect.keys
tools.description: The keymap: which keys run which commands. Machine source when one exists, otherwise the [keys] overrides from gitten.toml with an honest degraded flag.

tools.name: dispatch
tools.description: Resolve a keypress to a command name through core::command, the way every client does. Degraded until a machine dispatch endpoint lands.

key.description: Key spelling as it appears in gitten.toml, e.g. j, ctrl-d, G.

tools.name: diffcheck
tools.description: Check core's differs against git's own answer on a real repository (changed-line counts and every hunk position).

tools.name: bench
tools.description: Pipeline timings at fixture scale (full), or the cost of one headless frame (quick).
